Your objection is to the "(Rank)" tag in the page name? or to the page being different then Asha'man for a 'sub-topic'?  [[Asha'man]] is the page discussing the organisation Asha'man (namely the black tower), [[Asha'man (Rank)]] is the page discussing the highest standard rank a member of the Black Tower can achieve.  Both the rank and the organisation share the name Asha'man.  (Rank) was added to disambigate the two, and complete the series of pages on the standard ranks of the Black Tower (namely [[Soldier]], [[Dedicated]], and [[Asha'man (Rank)|Asha'man]]). (Note that in text you should never see (Rank), just [[Asha'man (Rank)|Asha'man]]) [[User:Melriken|Melriken]] 19:23, 28 January 2008 (UTC)

: I object to both things in this case, since the "sub-topic" does not have a unique name.
